title: A musical house: singers and orchestras at his mother's birthday
summary: Popular singers and orchestras such as Maria Teresa Vera, Floro Zorrilla and Antonio Maria Romeu played at family parties.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I see. Okay, now at that time while this is going on, You were aware of music?

Naturally, because my father was a good singer. You know, when I heard Panchito Riset for the first time, I remembered my father; my father had that type of voice, like Panchito Riset, when he was very young; and my house was a musical house because the day of my mother's birthday was a happy thing there, day before, the day and the day after. So we had Maria Teresa, we had Floro and Miguel, we had all the singers, all the popular singers in Havana. They was coming to my house to sing and celebrate my mother's birthday; and then Calabaza, la orquesta Calabaza, Antonio Maria Romeu and you name it, practically everyone.
Your father used to hire these musicians . . . .
And they used to play inside your house?
And who else used to go to the party?

Well, practically everyone. All the people that he was doing business with and the people in the neighborhood because my father was a very liberal guy. There was a lot of poor people. He was practically the only one, rich one in the neighborhood because it was a very,very poor neighborhood.
Okay,Macho. Who were you aware of musically at that time? - when you were about nine or ten. Who was saying anything to you?
Well, ah - - Maria Teresa and - - Maria Teresa, Floro, Floro Zorilla, he was a good singer.
Maria Teresa Vera. That was ah ----
They came after el Sexteto Habanero, am I right?
Before, I am talking about ten - when I was - ten years. The Habanero came about 1922, so that was twelve years after.
